summary: Layer 1B expansion found one reference anchor and three underfollowed or second-order US-listed candidates tied to compliant rare-earth magnet supply. The most direct reference is MP Materials, because it is building an integrated mine-to-magnet chain with DoD support. The underfollowed lane is more interesting: USA Rare Earth is a newly public integrated NdFeB magnet platform; Compass Diversified hides Arnold Magnetic Technologies, an established magnet and precision-component supplier, inside a diversified holding company; and Energy Fuels is an upstream oxide/feedstock chokepoint that could matter if defense waivers force proof of non-Chinese oxide-to-metal-to-magnet provenance. Key evidence gap: customer qualification and compliant feedstock traceability are more important than headline mine or magnet capacity.
